title: expr-op-count: Verify 30th ExprOp variant or document 29 as canonical
description: Chore S-20. Master §14 requires 30 ExprOp variants. vb_core::workflow::types::ExprOp has 29. The compiler mirror in vb_compile/src/expression_bytecode.rs:552-568 also has 29. compile_to_generated_rust is removed per master §68 (target contract: IR interpreter is the only execution mode) but still exists in vb_compile/src/compile/mod.rs:724-730. The drift between code (29) and master (30) is a documentation/code mismatch. This bead: (1) confirm with the master doc owner which 30th variant was intended; (2) if confirmed, add the variant to ExprOp, helper_op in vb_expr/bytecode/mod.rs:251-267, and the compiler mirror; (3) if not, update master §14 to say 29; (4) handle the compile_to_generated_rust removal: either remove the function or update master to clarify the codegen path is test-only.

THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT have compile_to_generated_rust in production code if master §68 removes codegen

unwanted.because: Master §14: 30 variants is the contract; drift is a doc lie
